code='''def transform(grid):
    """Keep cells where both panels contain a non-background mark; recolor them 2."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    # The panels are separated by a full-height, uniform divider.
    divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)]
    sep = min(divs, key=lambda c: abs(c - w // 2))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    if len(left[0]) != len(right[0]):
        raise ValueError("panel widths differ")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
            for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]
'''
